transcript.text: Good evening, everyone. I'd like to get our pre-opening routine underway for the Saturday premiere screening at the Riverside Courtyard. As we normally do, I'll need to hear final status reports from production, insurance, and talent coordination in turn before I record the operating plan and make the approval. Who would like to start?

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical safety issue. My production safety check this morning found that the courtyard screen rig is rated for sustained wind up to 18 mph, but the Saturday forecast is 22 mph. Harbor Hall has a certified indoor rig and a maximum audience capacity of 600. I haven't entered this in the shared production log yet, but given the wind rating concern, I strongly recommend we consider moving the premiere to Harbor Hall.
